site.title: Harbor Ledger | Back-office teams in Ho Chi Minh City
site.description: Harbor Ledger runs accounting, data and software teams in Ho Chi Minh City for logistics, retail and finance companies in the US, the UK and Japan.

data.title: Back-office and software teams in *Ho Chi Minh City*
data.lead: Harbor Ledger closes the books, cleans order data and builds internal tools for logistics, retail and finance companies, from one office with 210 staff.

photo.alt: Ho Chi Minh City skyline at dusk

head.title: Nine service lines, one office
head.lead: Each service has its own team lead and its own page. Hover a name to see where the work happens.

head.title: What each team runs
head.lead: Scroll the list to see how each piece of work is set up inside the Ho Chi Minh City office.

items.title: Month-end close
items.text: Accountants reconcile banks and cards, post accruals and send a close pack by the fifth working day.

photo.alt: Month-end documents under review on a desk

items.title: Invoice processing
items.text: Supplier invoices are coded, matched to orders and queued for approval in your accounting system.

photo.alt: Invoice approved next to a laptop

items.title: Payroll preparation
items.text: Payroll runs are prepared from your timesheets, checked by a second person and sent for sign-off.

photo.alt: Payroll sheets being checked on a desk

items.title: Stock reports
items.text: Daily stock counts from your warehouse system become one report with movements and exceptions.

photo.alt: Warehouse aisle with boxes on shelves

items.title: Internal tools
items.text: Engineers build the small web tools your back office needs, such as approval queues and upload portals.

photo.alt: Open-plan office in Ho Chi Minh City

items.title: Release testing
items.text: Testers run your regression suite on each release candidate and log bugs in your own tracker.

photo.alt: Laptop open in a meeting room for a test review

items.title: Weekly client review
items.text: Your account lead walks through output, error counts and open issues with you in a weekly call.

photo.alt: Meeting room set up for a weekly review

head.title: Who we work for
head.lead: Most clients move goods or money; each industry has a team lead who knows its documents.

items.title: Logistics
items.text: Freight documents, proof of delivery and carrier invoices for forwarders.

items.title: Retail and e-commerce
items.text: Order cleanup, returns data and catalog updates for online sellers.

items.title: Financial services
items.text: Reconciliations and reporting for lenders, brokers and payment firms.

items.title: Property
items.text: Rent ledgers, service charge accounts and tenant records for managers.

items.title: Healthcare
items.text: Claims data entry and billing checks with access limited to named staff.

data.title: Hand off the work that slows your *back office*
data.text: Send a short brief and a team lead replies with a staffing plan and a price range.

data.blurb: Accounting, data and software teams in Ho Chi Minh City for clients in the US, the UK and Japan.
